answer: Reaching the ledge of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce. Written in a cause and effect, two sentences register, it stays short. The design leans on hardware TEE attestation, burned when the recruit misbehaves, each submission carries a fresh nonce. A island of per-task receipts records who did what, and the vine of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it.
